'''Kazza-Ki Sagree''' was an [[Aki-Aki]] [[Youngling|child]] who was [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[planet]] [[Pasaana]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> Sagree attended the [[Festival of the Ancestors]], an Aki-Aki festival celebrated every forty-two [[Standard year|years]], alongside a number of other Aki-Aki children<ref name="Episode IX">{{Film|IX}}</ref> in [[35 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IX}} to [[35 ABY]].</ref> During the festival, Sagree sat together with many other children and listened to a story being told to them.<ref name="Episode IX" /> While listening, Sagree smiled at a joke that they were eager to tell.<ref name="TROS VD" />

Sagree had [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s and tan skin and wore red [[robe]]s and a pink [[necklace]], along with a blue-and-green [[bracelet]] around the right [[Limb|wrist]]. Like all Aki-Aki young, Sagree was communally raised and was a celebrated guest at the festival, as the Aki-Aki children represented their people's future.<ref name="TROS VD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kazza-Ki Sagree first appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']].<ref name="Episode IX" /> She was identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TROS VD" />
